hoverScale.$description: Grow: the ring swells on hover.

pressScale.$description: Grow: the ring squishes while pressed.

popScale.$description: Grow: peak swell as a radio becomes selected.

settleScale.$description: Grow: brief undershoot before the ring settles.

previewDot.$description: Grow: size of the faint dot previewed on hover, as a fraction of the selected dot.

dotOvershoot.$description: Grow: how far the selected dot overshoots its size as it springs in.

ripple.$description: Ripple: how far the ring ripples out when a radio is chosen.

halo.$description: Ripple: width of the soft halo around a hovered radio.

drop.$description: Bounce: how far above the centre the dot falls from, and below it drops to when deselected.

rebound.$description: Bounce: height of the dot's small rebound.

squashWide.$description: Bounce and Jelly: horizontal stretch as the ring squashes.

squashTall.$description: Bounce and Jelly: vertical squash as the ring squashes.

hoverWide.$description: Jelly: horizontal stretch of a hovered ring.

hoverTall.$description: Jelly: vertical squash of a hovered ring.

travelStretch.$description: Travel: how much the selection stretches along its path mid-flight.

travelPinch.$description: Travel: how much the selection narrows across its path mid-flight.

thickenHoverHole.$description: Thicken: the open centre of a hovered ring, as a fraction of the radio (the ring thickens slightly).
